RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIND
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select d.id, d.doc_type || ' ' || d.doc_no || ' ' || to_char(d.doc_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') text, nvl(c.name, s.name) partner from mm_doc d left join mm_customer c on c.id = d.customer_id left join mm_supplier s on s.id = d.supplier_id where d.doc_type in ('TPY', 'PPY', 'TAG', 'PAG') order by d.doc_date desc, d.id desc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DTYPE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, name from mm_doc_type where code in ('TPY', 'PPY', 'TAG', 'PAG') order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CUST
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, name from mm_customer where active = 'Y' order by name

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SUPP
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, name from mm_supplier where active = 'Y' order by name

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PAY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select 'CREDIT' code, mm_text.t('T0A59F78A') descr from dual union all select 'CASH' code, mm_text.t('T360189BA') descr from dual union all select 'CARD' code, mm_text.t('T74C8F084') descr from dual

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ITEMI
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, code || ' ' || name text from mm_item where active = 'Y' and is_model = 'N' order by code
